opportunities.title: 3D Swim Toy Manufacturing Models
opportunities.description: Project Title: Fixed Budget (AUD): 3D Industrial Product Designer to Convert 2D Mascot Illustrations into 3D Manufacturing Models (Silicone Swim Toys) Project Description: IMPORTANT: To prove you have actually read this brief and are not an automated bot, please start your bid response with the word "SWIMMER". If this word is missing, your bid will be instantly deleted. 3D Product Designer Required – Packo & Daisy Squishy Sensory Swim Toys Project Overview iSwim2 is an Australian aquatic education brand looking for an experienced 3D Product Designer to transform our existing 2D cartoon characters, Packo the Penguin and Daisy the Duck, into 3D models suitable for manufacturing as soft, squishy sensory swim toys. These characters are part of our children's swimming product range. The toys will be used during swimming lessons for both sensory play above the water and underwater diving and retrieval activities. Our aim is to create appealing, tactile toys that children can hold, squeeze and explore while developing confidence and enjoyment in the water. We are particularly interested in designs that appeal to young children, including children who benefit from additional sensory engagement. We already have the original character illustrations. We need a designer who can retain their distinctive appearance while developing practical, functional 3D models that can progress towards commercial manufacture. 1. Design Requirements Both characters should have a soft, friendly, rounded appearance, with proportions suitable for small children's hands. Target age group: approximately 3–8 years. Target dimensions: maximum approximately 75 mm high x 65 mm wide, subject to design and manufacturing advice. Rounded, child-friendly forms without sharp edges or fragile projections. A satisfying squeeze response suitable for small hands. Sufficient durability for repeated squeezing, handling and use in chlorinated swimming pools. Designs that can be manufactured economically, with minimal unnecessary complexity. The 3D models must retain the key features, colours and personality of our original 2D illustrations. Packo the Penguin Packo's key features include his blue goggles, orange beak and feet, red swim trunks and blue towel. The design should incorporate these features into a cohesive toy, avoiding loose attachments or delicate projections that could break during use. Where practical, the swim trunks should include raised polka-dot details, and the towel could feature subtle raised ridges to provide additional tactile interest. Daisy the Duck Daisy's key features include her yellow body, orange feet, pink swimsuit and red hair bow. The design should retain these recognisable features while incorporating them into a cohesive, rounded toy. Soft raised ridges on her wings and hair details would be desirable tactile features. All character details should be designed with durability, cleaning and economical manufacture in mind. Where possible, clothing and accessories should be incorporated into the main body rather than manufactured as separate pieces. 2. Functionality – A Key Part of the Project The toys are intended for two types of water play: A. Squeeze and sink Our preferred concept is for children to squeeze the toy to expel air, allow water to enter, and release it so that it can sink underwater. Children can then dive to retrieve it. The designer will need to assess how this could work in practice, including the internal cavity, opening position and size, material flexibility, water entry and air release. The toy must also be capable of draining and drying appropriately between uses. We do not want a design that unnecessarily traps water inside. B. Sensory squeeze toy The toys should also provide a pleasant tactile and squeezing experience when handled above the water. If the sink-and-squeeze function cannot be achieved reliably in a single design, I would welcome the designer's advice on practical alternatives. For example, we could investigate a different internal structure or a separate weighted version. Please explain any limitations, additional manufacturing requirements or cost implications associated with the proposed solution. 3. Material and Manufacturing Considerations The models will ultimately be supplied to a manufacturer for assessment and production. Potential materials include suitable soft TPR or liquid silicone rubber (LSR), depending on the final design and manufacturing process. The designer should have an understanding of product design for manufacture (DFM), including: Appropriate wall thickness and flexibility for a hollow design. Moulding requirements, draft angles and parting lines. Avoiding problematic undercuts and fragile details. Suitable construction for repeated squeezing and use in chlorinated water. Practical methods for incorporating any internal weighting, if required. Design choices that help minimise tooling and production costs. If the hollow sink-and-squeeze concept is selected, a starting wall-thickness target of approximately 2.5–3 mm may be investigated, but the final specification should be based on the material, dimensions and manufacturing process. Important: I am looking for practical design advice, not simply a visually attractive 3D character. The proposed design must be realistic to manufacture and suitable for its intended use. 4. Required Deliverables The project covers both Packo and Daisy. The successful designer will provide: Two completed 3D character models based on the supplied illustrations. High-quality renders showing each character from multiple angles. STL and OBJ files suitable for prototype production and review. Editable CAD source files and production-oriented STEP/STP files, or equivalent formats agreed with the designer and confirmed as suitable for the intended manufacturer. A brief explanation of the proposed internal construction and how the sink-and-squeeze function is intended to work. Any important manufacturing considerations or limitations identified during the design process. The files must be supplied in a form that can be shared with prospective manufacturers for technical assessment and quotation. The project is for 3D design and modelling only. Physical prototyping, mould manufacture and mass production are not included in this initial contract unless separately quoted and agreed. All final agreed files must be supplied to iSwim2, with the agreed rights to use and modify the designs for commercial manufacture. 5. What I Am Looking For Please apply if you have experience in one or more of the following: 3D product or industrial design. Organic character modelling and translating 2D illustrations into 3D products. Soft toys, squeeze toys, silicone or TPR products. Product design for injection moulding or other suitable moulding processes. Designing hollow, flexible products or products with internal weights. Experience with children's products and sensory products would be an advantage. Please include examples of relevant work in your proposal, particularly products that have progressed from a 3D model to actual manufacture. 6. Budget and Proposal Requirements iSwim2 is a small Australian business, so budget is an important consideration. I am looking for a practical, cost-effective solution rather than an unnecessarily complex design. Please provide: Your fixed-price quote in AUD for both characters. Your estimated turnaround time. A brief outline of how you would approach the project. Confirmation of the file formats you can supply. Relevant examples of previous work. Any initial concerns or recommendations regarding the sink-and-squeeze function. Please identify any assumptions or additional costs upfront. I would prefer to agree on a clear scope and fixed price before commencing work. Thank you. I look forward to reviewing your proposals. Lyn Please note: Intellectual Property and Confidentiality Packo the Penguin and Daisy the Duck are iSwim2 characters. All supplied illustrations and reference artwork remain the property of iSwim2 or their respective rights holder. The artwork is provided solely for the purpose of quoting on and completing this project. It must not be copied, distributed, published, reproduced or used for any other purpose without written permission. The successful freelancer will be required to agree to written terms covering confidentiality, ownership and transfer of intellectual property rights for the completed 3D models and associated design files.

The design should incorporate these features into a cohesive toy, avoiding loose attachments or delicate projections that could break during use. Where practical, the swim trunks should include raised polka-dot details, and the towel could feature subtle raised ridges to provide additional tactile interest. Daisy the Duck Daisy's key features include her yellow body, orange feet, pink swimsuit and red hair bow. The design should retain these recognisable features while incorporating them into a cohesive, rounded toy. Soft raised ridges on her wings and hair details would be desirable tactile features. All character details should be designed with durability, cleaning and economical manufacture in mind. Where possible, clothing and accessories should be incorporated into the main body rather than manufactured as separate pieces. 2. Functionality – A Key Part of the Project The toys are intended for two types of water play: A. Squeeze and sink Our preferred concept is for children to squeeze the toy to expel air, allow water to enter, and release it so that it can sink underwater. Children can then dive to retrieve it. The designer will need to assess how this could work in practice, including the internal cavity, opening position and size, material flexibility, water entry and air release. The toy must also be capable of draining and drying appropriately between uses. We do not want a design that unnecessarily traps water inside. B. Sensory squeeze toy The toys should also provide a pleasant tactile and squeezing experience when handled above the water. opportunities.title: Asistente Telefónico Citas Belleza y Estética
opportunities.description: Busco un asistente remoto que atienda principalmente llamadas entrantes con el objetivo de agendar citas para mi centro de belleza y estética. Necesito una voz amable, organizada y capaz de transmitir confianza a cada cliente desde el primer “hola”. Responsabilidades clave • Responder llamadas en español con trato cercano y profesional. • Registrar nombre, servicio solicitado y datos de contacto de cada cliente. • Verificar disponibilidad y confirmar la cita en nuestro calendario online. • Enviar recordatorios breves por WhatsApp o correo cuando sea necesario. • Llevar un registro diario de llamadas atendidas y citas agendadas. Qué espero recibir de tu propuesta • Ejemplos concretos de tu trabajo anterior gestionando llamadas o agendas. • Breve descripción de las herramientas que utilizas (p. ej., Google Calendar, CRM, centralitas virtuales). • Tu disponibilidad horaria y zona horaria. Valoraré experiencia previa en recepción de spa, salones o centros estéticos, aunque no es imprescindible si demuestras habilidades telefónicas sólidas y atención al detalle. La colaboración iniciará de forma remota y puede convertirse en un acuerdo a largo plazo si encajamos bien. Espero tu propuesta.

opportunities.description: Preciso de uma animação de abertura em 3D, com tom sério e profissional, para o meu canal Nerd Rick. A intro deve ter entre 5 e 8 segundos, apresentar de forma marcante o logotipo e o nome do canal e manter a identidade visual que já uso (enviarei o arquivo vetorial do logo). Entregáveis esperados: • Storyboard ou animatic curto para aprovar ritmo e enquadramento. • Versão final em 1920×1080 e 4K, nos formatos .mp4 e .mov com canal alpha. • Arquivos-fonte editáveis do software escolhido (Blender, Cinema 4D, After Effects, etc.). • Um frame estático em .png para miniatura. Requisitos de seleção: • Portfólio consistente de animação 3D. • Cumprimento de prazo de até 7 dias após a aprovação do storyboard. • Comunicação clara em português. opportunities.title: Bilingual Phlebotomy Appointment Setter
opportunities.description: Bilingual Appointment Setter / Lead Generation Specialist (Phlebotomy). We are a mobile phlebotomy and clinical laboratory specimen collection service operating in New York. We are hiring proactive, fluent bilingual (English/Spanish) appointment setters and outbound callers to book in-home and corporate blood collection appointments. Responsibilities: Contact leads via phone calls, SMS, and WhatsApp. Qualify patients by verifying zip code and confirming they have a valid doctor's lab requisition. Schedule appointment dates and times on our calendar. Send payment link to collect the initial $50 booking deposit to secure the slot. Requirements: 100% fluent English (clear verbal communication) and native/fluent Spanish. Prior experience in appointment setting, medical scheduling, or phone sales. Reliable internet connection and headset. Compensation: Commission-based paying $15 per confirmed and paid deposit, with flexible daily or weekly payouts.

Please let me know if you have relevant experience, your estimated price, and how long development would take. I'm looking for a reliable developer who may also be available for future updates.

opportunities.title: Short Funny Robot Prank Reel
opportunities.description: Main ek crisp, scroll-stopping social-media reel banwana chahta hoon jisme ek robot ek hilarious prank kare. Tone poori tarah se comedy rahe—audience ko pehle curiosity, phir ek quick laugh mile. Scope • Length: 15–30 seconds, vertical (1080×1920) so it posts cleanly to Reels, Shorts & TikTok. • Story beat: robot sets up, executes, aur punch-line reveal—all tightly paced. • Visual style: jo approach aapko zyada engaging lage (2D motion graphics, stylised 3D, ya mixed-media), bas final output reel-ready ho. • Sound: upbeat background track + well-timed effects to heighten the prank. • Captions/Subtitles: burnt-in Hindi or Hinglish captions for mute viewers. Deliverables - Final MP4 reel (H.264) - Separate audio-mixed file (WAV/AIFF) - Source project files (After Effects, Blender, etc.) for future tweaks - One thumbnail/frame suggestion that teases the prank Acceptance Mujhe first cut ke baad ek review window milega; 1–2 minor revisions included so timing aur punch perfect ban sake. Agar aapko comedy timing, snappy edits, aur robot animation ka experience hai, to yeh quick gig aapke liye ideal hai. Let’s make people laugh in under half a minute!

opportunities.title: AI Website Updates WhatsApp Alerts
opportunities.description: Several times a day I need to know when certain sites publish new files, notices, or documents, but only the items that truly matter to me. Please build a small service that: • Polls a configurable list of URLs on a fixed schedule (cron or serverless job is fine) and detects any brand-new file, notice, or formal document. • Runs each new find through an AI summariser to judge its relevance and discard noise. • For every item that survives that filter, generates a concise WhatsApp message containing: – an AI-written summary, – the key dates or deadlines mentioned, and – the action I’m expected to take (plus a link or file reference). • Pushes that message straight to my personal WhatsApp via the WhatsApp Business Cloud API, Twilio, or another reliable gateway. • Lets me edit the site list, crawl frequency, and basic wording from a simple config file or lightweight web console. • Logs what was fetched, what was ignored, and what was sent so I can audit the process. I’m happy with Python, Node, or another mainstream stack as long as you document the install steps and hand over clean, well-commented code plus a one-click deployment script (Docker or serverless preferred). The final solution should be ready for me to drop my API keys in, start the scheduler, and begin receiving actionable WhatsApp alerts without further babysitting. Also Whats app ai agent to handle customer.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40783857, publicado hace 7 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: INR 10,000 - 12,000.

opportunities.title: Targeted Dark-Web Threat Monitoring
opportunities.description: I need a seasoned threat-intel analyst to keep a constant eye on the parts of the underground where our name or our sector might surface. The focus is squarely on tracking threats that target my organisation, so your daily hunting ground will be the dark-web forums and marketplaces notorious for trade in exploits, as well as credential-sharing and leaked-data sites where stolen logins quietly circulate. Here’s how I picture the engagement working: • You patrol those sources using whatever combination of Tor, specialised search engines, automation scripts, and manual reconnaissance you prefer, always maintaining strict OPSEC. • Any post, listing, or dump that references us—or clearly applies to companies in our industry—gets captured immediately with screenshots, source URL, date/time, and the full text or file. • If you spot credentials, network details, or chatter about an impending attack aimed at our systems, I want an immediate alert by encrypted message. • Otherwise, a concise weekly brief (PDF or Markdown) summarising new findings, trends, and your assessment of risk will be enough. The raw evidence matters as much as your analysis, so please preserve hashes, metadata, and any other artefacts that let me validate provenance. Feel free to enrich data with VirusTotal, Have I Been Pwned, or similar tools if it strengthens the report, but the core value is the underground collection itself. Let me know what tooling and workflow you favour and how quickly you can start.

The raw evidence matters as much as your analysis, so please preserve hashes, metadata, and any other artefacts that let me validate provenance. Feel free to enrich data with VirusTotal, Have I Been Pwned, or similar tools if it strengthens the report, but the core value is the underground collection itself. Let me know what tooling and workflow you favour and how quickly you can start."

opportunities.title: Build Profitable AI Online Business
opportunities.description: I’m ready to roll out a brand-new online venture that taps into AI and is capable of bringing in £5–10 k per month, with clear headroom for continued growth. My strongest pull is toward selling digital products or courses and high-value AI-driven services for businesses, yet I’m open to any model you can demonstrate has worked before. What I expect from you Show me proof—live stores, dashboards, revenue screenshots, testimonials—of previous builds where you took an AI-based idea from concept to consistent cash flow. Tell me exactly what you did, the obstacles you fixed, and why that experience makes you the right partner here. Scope of work (30-day launch window) • Pinpoint the most viable, proven concept and map the revenue pathway to reach £5–10 k/month. • Validate the market quickly with real data, then build the core offer (course, digital product, or service package). • Set up the tech stack: AI content generation (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney), automation via Zapier/Make, sales funnel, payment gateway, email sequences, analytics. • Deliver launch-ready branding, landing pages, and a concise go-to-market plan—including paid/organic traffic strategies—to flip the switch and start selling. • Provide SOPs so the business can scale or be handed off smoothly after launch. Acceptance criteria 1. A fully functional, client-ownable online asset that is taking payments by Day 30. 2. A documented funnel and automation map showing exactly how AI is used to minimise manual workload. 3. A 90-day growth roadmap that projects the path to £5–10 k/month using realistic KPIs pulled from your earlier successes. If you’ve built something similar and can replicate or enhance that success with me, I’d like this to grow into an ongoing partnership after the initial build. Pitch your proven idea, attach evidence, and let’s get started.

opportunities.title: Viral Civil Rights Landing Page. id261023
opportunities.description: I need a high-impact, single-screen website that drives visitors to sign a petition calling attention to an ongoing civil-rights injustice. The page must feel urgent, emotionally engaging, and instantly shareable while remaining fact-driven: the people affected have supplied documents and hard data that need to be worked seamlessly into the copy, visuals, and metadata so supporters can verify and spread the message with confidence. Because visibility is everything, the build has to be extremely tightly tuned for SEO and AEO. Structured data, FAQ/How-To schema, speed optimization, and answer-box targeting should all be baked in from the start so we can climb to page-one results quickly. Smooth clear CTA and a frictionless petition form are non-negotiable. Turnaround is extremely short, so I’m looking for an end-to-end solution that covers layout, responsive build, micro-copy, analytics tagging, and technical on-page optimization in one sprint. Acceptance criteria: • Mobile-first • Integrated petition form with exportable CSV of signatories • All supplied documents/facts presented in an easy-to-share format • SEO & AEO essentials: title/meta, schema markup, compressed assets, XML sitemap • Delivery of final code plus If you are confident you can produce a landing page that sparks viral momentum while meeting these technical checkpoints, let’s move fast. IF you also do viral marketing campaigns, please include that in your bid. MUST INCLUDE EXAMPLES OF OTHER MARKETING CAMPAINGS. TO PROVE YOU ARE NOT A BOT WHEN BIDDING. Include Pros and Cons to hiring you. Failure to include Pros, Cons, and Sample work, then I may ignore your bid.

opportunities.title: 30-Minute 3D Christmas Animation
opportunities.description: Christmas After Midnight is a 30-minute, family-friendly fantasy about Rowan Vale, a young apprentice After Keeper who discovers Christmas magic doesn’t vanish when the clock strikes twelve—it simply shifts to a hidden realm that must be protected. The script and storyboards are complete; what remains is turning those pages into a fully produced 3D animated film. Scope of work The entire production pipeline is in your hands. From modelling and rigging the characters and environments to lighting, animating, rendering, voice casting/recording, sound design, score mixing and final picture edit, I need a single studio or tightly coordinated team that can deliver a polished, cinematic-quality movie in a modern 3D animated style. Key tools and expectations are industry standards—Maya, Blender, Houdini, Unreal, or equivalent for animation and rendering; Pro Tools, Reaper or similar for ADR, Foley and final mix—so long as the final output meets broadcast/streaming specs (4K UHD master, 5.1 mix plus stereo fold-down). Deliverables • A 30-minute finished film, ready for distribution (4K .mov or .mp4, 5.1 + stereo WAV). • Separate dialogue, music and effects stems. • Project files (scenes, rigs, textures) archived for future use. • Credits list and legal clearances for all voice and audio assets. Acceptance criteria The picture must match the approved animatic in timing, exhibit smooth character performance at 24 fps, include fully synced dialogue, and pass a QC review for audio balance, loudness and colour consistency. I’m flexible on workflow as long as milestones are clear: asset build, first animation pass, lighting/render tests, rough cut with temp audio, final mix and picture lock. Let’s discuss schedule and any pipeline preferences so we can bring Rowan’s after-hours Christmas adventure to life.

From modelling and rigging the characters and environments to lighting, animating, rendering, voice casting/recording, sound design, score mixing and final picture edit, I need a single studio or tightly coordinated team that can deliver a polished, cinematic-quality movie in a modern 3D animated style. Key tools and expectations are industry standards—Maya, Blender, Houdini, Unreal, or equivalent for animation and rendering; Pro Tools, Reaper or similar for ADR, Foley and final mix—so long as the final output meets broadcast/streaming specs (4K UHD master, 5.1 mix plus stereo fold-down). Deliverables • A 30-minute finished film, ready for distribution (4K .mov or .mp4, 5.1 + stereo WAV). • Separate dialogue, music and effects stems. • Project files (scenes, rigs, textures) archived for future use. • Credits list and legal clearances for all voice and audio assets. Acceptance criteria The picture must match the approved animatic in timing, exhibit smooth character performance at 24 fps, include fully synced dialogue, and pass a QC review for audio balance, loudness and colour consistency. I’m flexible on workflow as long as milestones are clear: asset build, first animation pass, lighting/render tests, rough cut with temp audio, final mix and picture lock. Let’s discuss schedule and any pipeline preferences so we can bring Rowan’s after-hours Christmas adventure to life."

opportunities.title: Hand-Drawn Fantasy Card Art Commission
opportunities.description: Artist Wanted – 355 Original Hand-Drawn Illustrations for NEXALI Fantasy Card Game Category: 2D Game Art / Fantasy Illustration / Character Design Style: Anime / Manga / Fantasy Creature Art Budget: €2,000–€3,000 (Fixed Price) Total Artwork Units: 355 AI-Generated Artwork: Not Permitted Project Overview We are developing an original fantasy trading-card video game featuring collectible creatures, evolutions, strategic battles, deck building, human characters and an established fictional world. The game is already developed, and all existing creature designs, characters, card illustrations and visual references are available. We are looking for a talented illustrator or small professional art team to create original, human-drawn versions of our existing designs. Important: We are not asking you to invent 355 new concepts from scratch. The characters, creatures, colour schemes and artwork compositions already exist. Your task is to recreate these designs through original human-drawn artwork, remaining as faithful as reasonably possible to their established appearances. We welcome your artistic style, but significant redesigns are not required. 1. Artwork Requirements — 355 Units The complete commission consists of: Artwork Category Quantity creature and evolution cards 216 Legendary / God cards 7 Support and action card illustrations 78 Human characters and portraits 50 Complete world map 1 other 3 Total 355 All 301 game cards require their own specified artwork compositions. Where creatures or characters appear across multiple cards, their established designs should remain consistent. A complete artwork inventory with reference images, names and identification numbers will be provided to the selected artist under the agreed confidentiality arrangements. 2. Black-and-White and Coloured Artwork Each of the 355 artwork units requires two production stages. Stage 1 — Original Black-and-White Drawing One hand-drawn black-and-white approval sketch per artwork unit. Accurate proportions, distinguishing features and composition. Close resemblance to the existing reference artwork. Client approval before colouring begins. Stage 2 — Finished Coloured Artwork One completed coloured master per approved unit. Colours and distinguishing features matching the established designs. Consistent anime/manga-inspired visual quality. High-resolution artwork suitable for commercial use. Total deliverables: 355 black-and-white approval drawings and 355 corresponding coloured final masters. These are two stages of the same 355 artworks, not 710 separate designs. 3. Poses, Angles and Backgrounds Each commissioned design requires one primary illustration or viewing angle based on the existing references. Additional front, rear, side or three-quarter views are not required unless explicitly identified in the final inventory. Creature and character illustrations should closely follow the original poses and designs where practical. Support and action cards may include environments, creatures, objects, special effects or other compositions already established in the game. The world map must follow the existing geographical design, including its important locations and landmarks. This commission does not include animation, 3D models, full manga pages, game programming or additional character turnaround sheets. 4. Technical Deliverables Card illustrations: 3000 × 4500 pixels. 2:3 portrait aspect ratio. sRGB colour profile. High-resolution PNG exports. Human characters: One primary reference-based illustration per unit. Up to 3000 × 4500 pixels. Transparent background where applicable. World map: Coloured master illustration. At least 6000 pixels on its longest side. Original map proportions and recognizable geographical layout. Editable landmarks and labels. Symbols and objects: High-resolution colour versions. Editable vector files where applicable. Monochrome exports where required. Original editable files: We require properly organized editable source artwork, preferably: Native CorelDRAW (.cdr) files. Editable Adobe Illustrator (.ai) files. High-resolution PNG exports. Transparent versions where applicable. Separate editable layers or objects for important components. Artists using alternative professional software may propose equivalent editable formats, which must be agreed before the commission begins. Flattened images alone are not sufficient. 5. Original Human-Created Artwork All commissioned artwork must be genuinely human-created. Generative AI must not be used to produce the commissioned illustrations. We require: Original editable working files. Genuine preliminary sketches and development stages. Documentation of the creative process. Identification of the drawing software and tools used. Disclosure of any third-party resources or collaborators. Selected process recordings for agreed sample illustrations. Organized filenames corresponding to the artwork inventory. Existing game images may be used as visual references, but third-party copyrighted artwork must not be copied or traced without authorization. All process documentation must accurately reflect the actual work performed. 6. Commercial Rights and Intellectual Property The commission requires an agreement granting exclusive worldwide commercial usage rights to the commissioned artwork, subject to applicable copyright law. These rights must cover: PC, mobile, browser and console games. Steam, Apple App Store and other distribution platforms. Physical and digital trading cards. Manga, comics, books and related publications. Websites, social media, advertising and promotional materials. Animation, trailers and future adaptations. Merchandise, clothing, toys, collectibles and other products. Future games, expansions and sequels. Modification, recolouring, animation and adaptation. Sublicensing to commercial partners. Transfer to our future game-development company. Permission for future AI-assisted adaptations is also required. Although the commissioned artwork itself must be human-created, we intend to use the finished original illustrations as reference material for further AI-assisted game artwork, variations and development. The artist must explicitly permit this usage under the commercial rights agreement. The agreement will respect the artist's legal authorship and applicable mandatory rights while providing the commercial exploitation permissions required. 7. Timeline We understand this is a substantial project and are looking for a realistic production schedule. Please include: Your earliest possible starting date. Estimated illustrations completed per week. Time required for the initial paid test. Proposed schedule for black-and-white approvals. Proposed schedule for coloured final artwork. Estimated completion date for all 355 units. Whether you will work independently or with a small team. We value reliable communication, consistent quality and realistic commitments. 9. Project Budget €2,000–€3,000 — Fixed Price The budget covers the complete commission of 355 artwork units, including black-and-white approval drawings, coloured final versions, editable source files, agreed revisions, creation documentation and the required exclusive commercial usage rights. Please provide a fixed-price proposal for the entire specified project, including any applicable taxes, platform fees and other charges. All requirements and deliverables will be agreed in writing before full production begins. We are looking for artists who can offer competitive pricing for a large, reference-based illustration commission.

opportunities.title: Trending Roblox Vehicle Collection Simulator
opportunities.description: I want to partner with an experienced Roblox developer to launch a game where players focus on collecting, upgrading, and showing off vehicles, tools, and other machines. The core loop I have in mind is simple: explore → earn currency → unlock new gear → upgrade stats or cosmetics. Think of the satisfaction in Adopt Me’s pet meta, but swapped for cars, drills, drones—anything mechanical that can evolve over time. Key points I already know I want: • Goal for players: collect and continuously upgrade their items • Theme of collectibles: vehicles, tools, and machines (no cute pets or anime powers this time) • Monetisation: standard Roblox passes plus well-balanced micro-transactions, with revenue shared between us Where I’m flexible: • Exact genre wrapper—this could lean into a simulator, a light tycoon, or even an open-world adventure. I’m happy to refine that with you. • Art style and map size, as long as it feels polished and mobile-friendly. What you’d handle: – Scripting the core systems (currency, inventory, upgrade paths, data stores) in Lua – Building or overseeing low-poly 3D assets for the vehicles/tools, plus UI that clearly shows progression – Integrating monetisation hooks and analytics so we can adjust balancing after launch – Testing and optimising for smooth performance on mobile, tablet, and PC What I’ll handle: – Concept direction, marketing, community management, and paid ads once we hit beta – Funding any external asset packs or promotional spend we agree on Revenue share: I’m proposing a percentage split of net Robux, released in milestones: prototype, closed beta, full launch, live updates. We’ll set clear numbers together before we start. If building a Roblox title that can trend on the front page excites you, and you’re confident with Roblox Studio and Lua, let’s talk details and agree on the split.

opportunities.title: Recreate PDFs into CAD files. (.dwg)
opportunities.description: I have 3 PDF sheets that need to be redrawn in AutoCAD and returned as individual .dwg files. These are not rough sketches: every label, symbol, line weight, and connection must match the originals precisely, so the finished DWGs can be over-laid on the PDFs with zero visible deviation. I included a doc titled Perfect Sample so you can see what I am looking for. Any other suggestions are welcome. Page 1 Needs • This area. All Boxes Removed • Walls stay as is • Pillars need to be redrawn as they have been deleted Page 2 Needs This page. • All furniture removed • Pillars left in place. • All walls left as is area. • All rooms and offices, I need sizes in square feet Page 3 Needs The files must: • open cleanly in AutoCAD 2018 or newer • keep text editable (no exploded fonts) • follow logical layers so wires, symbols, and annotations can be toggled separately When you respond, attach or link to past work that demonstrates similar CAD accuracy; that’s the main thing I’ll review before awarding. Deliverables 1. Four separate DWG files—one per PDF—mirroring the diagrams exactly. This is a very simple task that should be done in 45-60 minutes for a person who knows what they are doing. Please don't waste your time or mine with bids over my offer. I would do this job myself, but I am traveling this week and dont have the time. I’ll review by doing a colour overlay of your DWGs against the source PDFs; any missing label, symbol, or misaligned line will need adjusting before final sign-off.

opportunities.title: Blender/Houdini Fire & Explosion VFX
opportunities.description: I’m creating a live-action cinematic shot that calls for big, believable pyrotechnics. What I need are production-ready fire and explosion simulations—no final composited renders, just the fully editable Blender or Houdini files so my team can light, re-time, and integrate them in post. The sequence features several elements: towering fireballs that roll into thick smoke plumes, controlled flames engulfing a vehicle and a portion of building façade, plus secondary details like sparks, drifting embers, and debris bursts. Real-world scale, convincing pressure, and natural dissipation are critical because the effects will sit right next to practical plates. You’re free to work in either Blender Mantaflow or Houdini Pyro/Sparse Pyro. As long as the caches and node networks are cleanly organised, parameterised, and clearly labelled, I can take it from there. Deliverables • Editable simulation file (.blend or .hip) with all caches linked or packed • Quick playblast or OpenGL preview for timing reference I’ll review on the basis of realism, continuity between the three effect types, and how easily the scene can be tweaked on my side. If this sounds like your specialty, let’s talk timing and shot specifics right away.

opportunities.title: Pomona Townhome Landscape & Irrigation Plans
opportunities.description: I’m seeking a landscape architect or experienced landscape designer to prepare a landscape and irrigation plan for a townhome project in Pomona, California. The project has a preliminary landscape concept and supporting project documents. The landscape area is approximately 3,500 sq. ft.; please verify the final plan limits against the supplied drawings. The plan should use the existing concept where feasible and address the City’s landscape submittal requirements and the supplied stormwater notes. Scope and deliverables - Review the preliminary landscape plan, AutoCAD site plan, LID report, plant list, stormwater notes, and City application materials. - Prepare a coordinated planting plan with plant names, quantities, sizes, spacing, and water-use categories or hydrozones. - Prepare an irrigation plan showing the system type, layout, zones, and irrigation components. - Include the plant-water-use calculation and applicable Appendix C worksheet in the drawing package. - Show an 8-foot-diameter no-plant area around each backyard tree. - Coordinate the landscape plan with the supplied stormwater/LID documents and notes. - Deliver a submission-ready PDF and editable CAD file. Civil engineering, revisions to the LID calculations, installation, and City fees are outside this scope. Please identify any assumptions or exclusions in your proposal. Please include your estimated turnaround time and confirm what is included in your fee. Please describe your experience with landscape and irrigation plans for California residential projects.

opportunities.title: Hard-Surface Model Topology Cleanup
opportunities.description: I am looking for a technical 3D modeler to perform localized mesh repair on a hard-surface sci-fi vehicle hull (Blender 5.1 / FBX workflow). Start your proposal with the exact phrase: 0,0,0 Origin Confirmed. Bids missing this exact phrase will be instantly declined. This is strictly a Topology Cleanup job, NOT a full retopology. The overall structural integrity and proportions of the model are final. Your task is to resolve n-gons and stray edges along a specific horizontal trim section, stitch the upper and lower hull meshes together cleanly, and dissolve unnecessary triangles across the main panels. Scope of Work: Target Area: The continuous lateral strake separating the upper angular cabin from the curved lower hull (see attached images highlighted in green). Surface Pinching Repair: Resolve the folded/pinched geometry on the upper side panel to ensure a perfectly flat, planar surface that will bake and shade cleanly in Substance 3D Painter without normal artifacts. Please include one sentence in your proposal explaining your technical approach to fixing this specific pinch. opportunities.title: AutoCAD Video Module for Design Course -- 3
opportunities.description: Title: AutoCAD Instructor: Record a Video Module for an Interior Design Course (From Scratch) Job Description: We are looking for an experienced AutoCAD instructor or an interior designer with top-tier drafting skills to record a comprehensive, beginner-friendly video learning module. The module will be integrated into our "Interior Design from Scratch" online course. During the course, our students receive a real property project brief and an empty floor plan. The goal of your module is to teach them AutoCAD fundamentals completely from scratch and guide them through creating their own individual floor plan based on the provided brief. Key Responsibilities: • Plan and record a step-by-step video module teaching AutoCAD to absolute beginners. • Guide students through the software interface, essential tools, and drafting workflows. • Use a real-world empty floor plan to demonstrate how to build an interior layout from a project brief. Approximate outline of what needs to be recorded: Module 1. Getting Started with AutoCAD • How to Successfully Complete the Module • Installing AutoCAD • Lesson 1. Downloading and Installing AutoCAD. How to install AutoCAD on your computer or laptop. Essential AutoCAD library for getting started. • Lesson 2. Getting Started and Essential Tools. How AutoCAD works. Understanding the interface and the essential tools you need to get started. • Lesson 3. Creating Geometric Shapes: Dimensions, Layers, and Properties Working with shapes, adding dimensions, using layers, and saving drawings. • Lesson 4. Creating a Technical Detail: Hatching and Projections. Creating a technical detail drawing and side view. Different types of hatching and how they are used. • Lesson 5. Creating a Measured Floor Plan. Applying your AutoCAD skills in practice. Transferring on-site measurements into AutoCAD and creating a measured floor plan. • Lesson 6. Room Schedule and Area Calculations. Creating a room schedule based on the measured floor plan. Room numbering and area calculations. • Lesson 7. Blocks and Groups. Creating blocks, understanding their properties and functionality, and working with furniture blocks. Module 2. Space Planning • Lesson 1. Introduction to Space Planning. Core principles of space planning. Ergonomics. Common technical mistakes. Understanding what clients typically expect from a space plan. • Lesson 2. Working with Small Spaces • Lesson 3. Space Planning in AutoCAD. Creating a space plan in AutoCAD. Drawing walls, placing furniture, adding furniture dimensions, and developing wall and partition plans. Requirements: • Good English communication skills with clear, articulate pronunciation. • Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple, accessible terms for beginners. Even if you haven't recorded similar lessons before, but you are confident you can handle it, please apply! • Expertise in AutoCAD applied specifically to interior design/architecture. Project Scope & Timeline: Please submit your proposals stating your estimated timeline and your fixed price for the complete course structure outlined above. How to Apply: • Please attach a couple of your drawings and confirm your readiness to record a 5-minute sample video after agreeing on the terms, so we can hear how you explain. • In your proposal, please state your approximate price for recording the entire volume of these modules. Hello! Please find the detailed project brief and technical requirements here: [https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Hafl5yoTAC5U5O-jHdo7Hcllfg40cwbu6iGo1RXl1dE/edit?usp=sharing]. The document outlines the project scope, expected deliverables, and other important details. Please let us know if you have any questions. Thank you!

opportunities.title: Bloqueo automático buzones Carbonio
opportunities.description: Trabajo con Carbonio CE 26.6.2 y debido a la eliminación de esta característica (limitación de tamaño de casillas) en la nueva versión, necesito automatizar el control de cuota de los buzones. Requiero un script ejecutado por cron (u otra alternativa que propongas) con las siguientes características: • Revisar periódicamente el tamaño de todos los buzones. • Aplicar un único límite global; al superarlo, la cuenta debe quedar impedida de enviar y recibir correos. • Mantener una whitelist configurable (por nombre de cuenta) que excluya determinadas casillas de la restricción. • Si un buzón bloqueado vuelve a quedar por debajo del límite, el sistema debe reactivar inmediatamente el envío y la recepción de mensajes. • Registrar en un log las acciones tomadas y, opcionalmente, enviar un resumen diario. • Entregar instrucciones claras de instalación, variables de configuración (límite en MB, ruta de la whitelist, frecuencia de ejecución) y comandos Carbonio/CLI empleados. Acepto propuestas o ideas nuevas que nos solucionen el problema, lo importante es que funcionen de forma fiable en la versión indicada. Al finalizar, espero el script completo, la guía de despliegue y una breve prueba de funcionamiento capturada en consola.

opportunities.title: Lighting Design – 3 Homes in Kerala & Tamil Nadu
opportunities.description: Three residential projects (1,500 + 2,300 + 1,500 sq ft) located in Kerala, Tirunelveli and Valliyur (Tamil Nadu). Remote work only, no site visit needed. For every house I need a complete, room-by-room lighting layout delivered both in PDF and editable DWG, DIALux-based lux calculations for the main spaces, a fixture schedule featuring readily available Indian brands with full specifications, clear switch grouping, and 3D views generated inside DIALux. Two revision rounds are part of the brief; photorealistic renders can be quoted as an optional extra. We will begin with House A as the first milestone. You will receive a floor plan that already shows room sizes, furniture layout and ceiling heights, but no reflected ceiling plan. The design direction is a warm, layered scheme: 3000 K for living areas and bedrooms, 4000 K for the kitchen, with subtle accent highlights in the living and dining zones. For House A please run detailed lux calculations in DIALux for the living room, dining, kitchen and all bedrooms; bathrooms and balconies only require a layout without calculations. When you reply, let me know: • your fee per house and equivalent rate per square foot • the timeframe you need for one house from kickoff to final files • confirmation that two revisions, the editable DWG and the native DIALux files are included If the first house meets expectations, the remaining two will follow immediately and future residential work will be offered at the same per-sq-ft rate. To help me assess fit, please attach two or three residential lighting samples along with one sample DIALux report that shows both the calculation summary and a rendered view. I look forward to collaborating with you on these homes.

opportunities.title: Recomendaciones de productos de cocina
opportunities.description: Necesito un informe claro y objetivo que me ayude a elegir los mejores artículos de cocina y alimentación para el uso diario en mi hogar. Busco que investigues y selecciones varias opciones para cada categoría clave (por ejemplo, ollas, sartenes, utensilios, pequeños electrodomésticos y soluciones de almacenamiento de alimentos). Qué espero recibir: • Una lista curada de productos con 2-3 alternativas por categoría. • Ficha breve de cada artículo: precio promedio, ventajas, posibles desventajas y por qué lo recomiendas. • Enlaces directos a tiendas confiables donde puedan comprarse online (idealmente disponibles en mi país). • Comparativa resumida al final con tu veredicto general y consejos de compra. Valoro que tengas experiencia en investigación de mercado, reviews de productos y conocimiento actualizado sobre materiales libres de tóxicos, eficiencia energética y facilidad de limpieza. Si manejas herramientas como Google Shopping, Keepa o extensiones de seguimiento de precios, menciónalo porque suma valor. El tono del informe debe ser práctico y fácil de leer; no necesito redacción publicitaria, sino recomendaciones fundamentadas en datos y experiencia real de usuarios.

opportunities.title: DARV Shaadi Card Game Writer
opportunities.description: Hey Aahil bhai, ek project ke liye aapse baat karni thi. Maine aapka profile dekha aur aapka Hinglish + meme/comedy wala work relevant laga, isliye project properly explain kar raha hoon. Main ek 36-card Indian party/card game bana raha hoon — DARV: SHAADI EDITION. Basic idea: India already chaotic hai. Humne bas us chaos ko game bana diya. Mujhe normal comedy script, screenplay ya long dialogues bilkul nahi chahiye. Mujhe short, punchy aur playable card lines chahiye jo game ke time padhte hi log react karein. Humor ka vibe: * Proper Hinglish, jaise friends/cousins actually baat karte hain * Modern Indian + Gen-Z humor * Current Instagram/Reels/meme culture * Real Indian situations * Shaadi, relatives, cousins, baraat, food, photographer, family WhatsApp, school/college, aunty questions, awkward family moments etc. * Unexpected punchlines * Absurd situations * Meme references * Would You Rather * Character comedy * Internet/meme formats * Thoda savage/dark humor chalega, but overall fun/party-game friendly rehna chahiye Sabse important: mujhe 2019 Facebook/WhatsApp meme wali comedy nahi chahiye. Example of what I DON’T want: “When your Indian mom asks about your career ” Ye bahut basic hai. Mujhe aisa feel chahiye: “Bhai ye card kisne approve kiya ” Matlab joke padhke actual reaction aaye — “WHAT ” / “BHAI ” / “YE KYA THA” Aisa nahi lagna chahiye ki kisi professional writer ne joke likhne ki bahut koshish ki hai. It should feel like 3 cousins shaadi mein raat ke 11 baje bore hokar sabko observe kar rahe hain aur bakchodi kar rahe hain. ⸻ MAIN CARD MECHANIC — START → TWIST Game ka ek important format START → TWIST hoga. Player ko START pata hoga, but TWIST nahi pata hoga. Example: START: “Shaadi ke stage pe tumhe randomly bula liya gaya hai. Tumhe 10 seconds ki speech deni hai.” Player speech start karega. Then card reader TWIST reveal karega: TWIST: “Ab imagine karo audience mein tumhare school ke saare teachers baithe hain.” Basically player ko pata hi nahi hona chahiye ki agla kya hone wala hai. Twist predictable nahi hona chahiye — situation ko suddenly 10x zyada ridiculous bana de. ⸻ Cards ke aur formats: WOULD YOU RATHER Do aise options jahan dono choices funny/awkward hon. MEME / INTERNET CARDS Current meme formats, POVs, internet language, brainrot-type formats etc. use kar sakte hain. But meme ko copy nahi karna — format/reference ko Indian situation mein creatively convert karna hai. opportunities.title: Closer Ventas Fitness Online
opportunities.description: Recibo todos los días contactos que dejan sus datos en un formulario después de ver mi anuncio de entrenamiento para perder peso. Necesito que tomes cada lead apenas entra en el CRM, le escribas, agendes una llamada rápida, profundices en sus objetivos y cierres la venta durante esa misma conversación telefónica. Las personas ya vienen convencidas de que necesitan bajar de peso; solo falta que alguien empático, directo y con buena energía les muestre cómo mi programa puede ayudarlas y concrete el pago. Por eso, tu principal métrica será la tasa de cierre y el tiempo que demores entre la entrada del lead y la llamada final. Uso habitual de WhatsApp, teléfono o Zoom (lo que el prospecto prefiera) y registro de todas las interacciones en el mismo CRM para poder medir tu rendimiento con claridad. Entrego acceso al guion base, testimonio de clientes y oferta detallada. Tú aportas habilidades de comunicación, control de objeciones y seguimiento hasta que el prospecto se convierta en alumno activo.

Alcance • Arquitectura de pantallas principales (login, panel del profesional, ficha del paciente, editor de menús/recetas, vista de plan del paciente y centro de mensajes). • Prototipo interactivo para iOS y Android en Figma o una herramienta equivalente, con flujo completo desde la creación del plan hasta el envío. • Guía de estilos (tipografías, paleta, iconografía y componentes reutilizables) para conservar coherencia en futuras iteraciones. Entregables mínimos 1. Wireframes de baja fidelidad validados conmigo. 2. Mock-ups de alta fidelidad y prototipo navegable. 3. Archivo maestro editable + assets exportables (.svg/.png). Criterios de aceptación – El editor de menús debe permitir añadir o modificar recetas por paciente de manera dinámica. – El plan debe poder visualizarse con una jerarquía clara (desayuno, almuerzo, cena, colaciones) y opción de compartir en un solo toque. – Interfaz simple, accesible y con buenas prácticas de UX para profesionales de la salud. Qué espero en tu propuesta Explícame tu proceso, tiempos y qué herramientas utilizarás; incluye un desglose de hitos y ejemplos de trabajos similares. Solo revisaré propuestas que traigan este nivel de detalle. Estoy abierto a sugerencias sobre funcionalidades secundarias como seguimiento de progreso o recordatorios, pero su inclusión no forma parte del alcance inmediato; prefiero centrar el esfuerzo de esta fase en la creación y envío de planes.

opportunities.title: Rediseño 2D Bowser Diésel
opportunities.description: Cuento con varias fotos recientes del bowser diésel y las medidas principales de su estructura. Necesito transformar esa información en un plano 2D completamente nuevo donde la distribución general y las dimensiones queden claras y bien proporcionadas. El dibujo resultante se presentará a un cliente para aprobación, por lo que debe verse limpio, profesional y fácil de leer. Aun así, lo esencial es que la planta y los alzados muestren con exactitud el tamaño del tanque, la posición de los ejes, guardabarros, escalones y demás elementos volumétricos: los detalles finos de tuberías o rótulos pueden mantenerse como referencia, pero el foco está en lograr un layout coherente y a escala. Entrego de inicio: • Carpeta con las fotografías. • Tabla con las medidas clave (largo total, ancho, alto del tanque, diámetro de ruedas, etc.). Espero de tu parte el archivo fuente (DWG o compatible) y un PDF listo para imprimir en formato ISO A1. Toda la acotación debe emplear unidades métricas y estilo estándar, y agradeceré que incluyas un pequeño cuadro resumen con la capacidad estimada del tanque calculada a partir de las nuevas dimensiones. Si tienes experiencia recalculando volúmenes y ajustando layouts de equipos móviles, este encargo te quedará cómodo. Podemos coordinar una breve videollamada para revisar dudas antes de que arranques.

opportunities.title: Frases Motivacionales Italianas Breves
opportunities.description: Necesito una colección de frases motivacionales escritas en italiano, pensadas para personas con baja autoestima. Las frases deben tener un tono profundo y reflexivo: quiero que inviten a la introspección, transmitan calma y, al mismo tiempo, siembren la certeza de que el cambio interior es posible. Uso principal Las publicaré sobre imágenes en redes sociales, por lo que cada frase debe ser lo bastante corta para encajar sin saturar la composición gráfica. Piensa en mensajes que impacten de un vistazo y dejen huella al releerse. Alcance y entregables • 40-50 frases originales, cada una de 8-12 palabras como máximo. • Formato: hoja de cálculo o documento con una frase por fila. • Una segunda columna con una breve explicación opcional (máx. 15 palabras) que me ayude a escoger la imagen adecuada; no aparecerá en la publicación final. Criterios de aceptación 1. Italiano natural, libre de errores gramaticales o giros forzados. 2. Tono siempre profundo y reflexivo, evitando clichés motivacionales demasiado obvios. 3. Sin plagio: todo debe ser contenido original; comprobaré frases en buscadores antes de aprobar. Si necesitas más contexto sobre la audiencia o ejemplos de estética visual, dímelo y los facilito de inmediato.

observed_data.verbatim_request: "Necesito una colección de frases motivacionales escritas en italiano, pensadas para personas con baja autoestima. Las frases deben tener un tono profundo y reflexivo: quiero que inviten a la introspección, transmitan calma y, al mismo tiempo, siembren la certeza de que el cambio interior es posible. Uso principal Las publicaré sobre imágenes en redes sociales, por lo que cada frase debe ser lo bastante corta para encajar sin saturar la composición gráfica. Piensa en mensajes que impacten de un vistazo y dejen huella al releerse. Alcance y entregables • 40-50 frases originales, cada una de 8-12 palabras como máximo. • Formato: hoja de cálculo o documento con una frase por fila. • Una segunda columna con una breve explicación opcional (máx. 15 palabras) que me ayude a escoger la imagen adecuada; no aparecerá en la publicación final. Criterios de aceptación 1. Italiano natural, libre de errores gramaticales o giros forzados. 2. Tono siempre profundo y reflexivo, evitando clichés motivacionales demasiado obvios. 3. Sin plagio: todo debe ser contenido original; comprobaré frases en buscadores antes de aprobar. Si necesitas más contexto sobre la audiencia o ejemplos de estética visual, dímelo y los facilito de inmediato."

opportunities.title: Edición dinámica para Reels
opportunities.description: Tengo varios videos ya grabados que quiero transformar en Instagram Reels ágiles y atractivos. Busco a alguien que: • Seleccione los mejores fragmentos y combine cortes rápidos • Añada textos en pantalla que refuercen el mensaje • Incorpore música libre de derechos y efectos de sonido acordes al ritmo • Ajuste color y audio para un acabado profesional • Entregue el archivo final en formato vertical 1080 × 1920 px (MP4) y, si es posible, el proyecto editable Proporciono todo el material de origen; solo necesitas tu creatividad y tu herramienta favorita (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve o similar). Quiero un flujo de trabajo claro y una comunicación rápida para afinar detalles y asegurar que cada Reel conserve coherencia visual con la marca. Si disfrutas creando piezas dinámicas con textos, música y cortes enérgicos, dime cuántos Reels puedes editar por semana y muestra ejemplos recientes de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Estrategia Integral de Marketing Digital y Soporte para Mezcal Arte...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional o equipo con experiencia en marketing digital y atención al cliente para impulsar la marca de mezcal artesanal "La Patrona". El objetivo principal es generar un impacto significativo en el mercado y aumentar la visibilidad del producto, así como gestionar las interacciones con posibles clientes. Las responsabilidades incluyen: - Desarrollar e implementar una estrategia de marketing digital robusta para el mezcal "La Patrona", buscando un crecimiento acelerado en el reconocimiento de marca. - Crear contenido atractivo y campañas publicitarias que resalten la calidad y el carácter artesanal del producto. - Gestionar la comunicación y responder a las preguntas de posibles clientes a través de los canales digitales, proporcionando información clara y persuasiva. - Asegurar que todas las actividades de promoción y comunicación cumplan estrictamente con las regulaciones para la venta y publicidad de bebidas alcohólicas. Es fundamental incluir advertencias como "No apto para menores de edad" y "El abuso del consumo es dañino para la salud" en todo material promocional. El candidato ideal debe tener un profundo conocimiento de las normativas de publicidad de alcohol, creatividad para el marketing de bebidas espirituosas y excelentes habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con el público. Se valorará la proactividad y la capacidad de generar ideas innovadoras para posicionar el mezcal "La Patrona" en el mercado. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: Community Management ¿Qué necesitas?: Marca mediana, nivel de interacción medio

opportunities.title: Fotografías de Vallas Digitales
opportunities.description: El encargo consiste en capturar imágenes nítidas y de alta resolución de 14 vallas digitales ubicadas en El Salvador. Las tomas deben mostrar claramente el contenido que se proyecta, la estructura completa de la valla y su entorno inmediato para que se aprecie la escala y el contexto. El trabajo es urgente y necesito contar con el material final lo antes posible. Entregables mínimos • Serie completa de fotografías en formato JPG (alta resolución). • Al menos tres ángulos por valla: plano general, plano medio y un acercamiento donde el mensaje digital se lea con total claridad. • Breve ficha por archivo con la localización (coordenadas o dirección), fecha y hora de la toma. Aceptación: las imágenes deben estar bien expuestas, libres de desenfoques, sin reflejos que oculten el contenido mostrado en la pantalla y con suficiente iluminación para uso comercial. Adjunta una propuesta detallada que incluya tu metodología, tiempos y cualquier recurso extra que consideres necesario para asegurar la cobertura completa dentro del plazo urgente indicado.
